protocols.name: Supplement Protocol
protocols.notes: Carried over from the previous app. Doses, reasoning and phase timing are as they were there — edit anything that has changed.

phases.name: Liver + Biofilm Prep — Detox + Biofilm Assault
Kidney + Biofilm Prep — Detox + Biofilm Assault
Heavy Metal Detox — Detox + Biofilm Assault
Cleanup Ramp-Up — Gut Deep Clean + Rebuild
Full Cleanup + Probiotics — Gut Deep Clean + Rebuild
Probiotic Diversification — Gut Deep Clean + Rebuild

items.name: Perfect Amino Powder
items.why: Amino acid foundation — fasted absorption optimal
items.notes: Essential amino acids in pre-digested form. Take first thing on empty stomach for maximum absorption. Mix in 8-12oz water.

items.name: Beta-Glucan (1,3/1,6)
items.why: Immune modulator — primes NK cells, macrophages, and neutrophils
items.notes: Immune modulator — primes NK cells, macrophages, and neutrophils. Supports Th1 immunity against parasites. Empty stomach required.

items.name: Naked Glutamine
items.dose: 5g stirred into hot morning tea. Dissolves best in hot liquid — eliminates clumping.
items.why: Gut lining fuel — feeds intestinal cell repair
items.notes: L-Glutamine is the primary fuel source for intestinal epithelial cells. Critical during detox when gut lining is under stress.

items.name: Lymphoria Drops
items.why: Opens lymphatic drainage pathways
items.notes: Homeopathic lymphatic drainage support. Hold under tongue 30 seconds before swallowing. Supports toxin removal through lymph system.

items.name: Trace Mineral Drops
items.dose: Per label in water. Can add to same hot tea as glutamine.
items.why: Mineral replenishment — critical during fasting + detox
items.notes: Full-spectrum ionic trace minerals. Detox and fasting deplete minerals rapidly. Add to your morning water. Can add to same hot tea as glutamine.

items.name: Colostrum
items.dose: Powder in morning water OR capsules with food (Breaking Fast)
items.why: Immunoglobulins + lactoferrin + growth factors for mucosal immunity and gut barrier repair
items.notes: Immunoglobulins (IgA, IgG) + lactoferrin + growth factors for mucosal immunity and gut barrier repair. Complements Silver Fern Cleanse but adds growth factors Cleanse doesn't have. Powder form: morning water on empty stomach. Capsule form: take with food at Breaking Fast. Do NOT add to hot liquids — heat destroys bioactive compounds.

items.name: Boost Blenz Detox Blend
items.why: Current detox phase — the backbone
items.notes: Phase-specific detox blend. Mix into coffee or tea. This is the primary detox driver for Phase 1.

items.name: Nattokinase
items.why: BIOFILM: Dissolves fibrin scaffolding in biofilm matrix
items.notes: Enzyme derived from natto (fermented soy). Breaks down fibrin, which is the structural scaffolding that biofilms use. Take on empty stomach for systemic effect.

items.name: Rho Glutathione
items.why: Master antioxidant — restores liver Phase II detox capacity
items.notes: Liposomal glutathione. The body's master antioxidant and primary liver detoxification molecule. Hold under tongue briefly before swallowing.

items.name: Standard Process Antronex
items.why: Liver decongestion — especially during liver cleanse
items.notes: Yakriton extract supporting liver detoxification. Especially important during the liver cleanse subphase.

items.name: MSM (from Glucosamine combo)
items.why: Sulfur donor for glutathione production
items.notes: Methylsulfonylmethane provides bioavailable sulfur needed to produce glutathione. Also supports joint health and reduces inflammation.

items.name: Methylene Blue (Meraki)
items.why: Mitochondrial support + mild antimicrobial. 2+ hrs from Nano Scrub.
items.notes: Pharmaceutical-grade methylene blue. Acts as an electron carrier in the mitochondrial electron transport chain. IMPORTANT: Space 2+ hours from Nano Scrub.

items.name: Rho NAD+
items.why: Cellular energy + sirtuin activation. Supports mitochondrial function during active detox.
items.notes: Liposomal NAD+ precursor. Supports cellular energy production, DNA repair, and activates sirtuins (longevity genes).

items.name: Rho Curcumin + Resveratrol
items.why: Anti-inflammatory + longevity. Replaces Qunol Turmeric.
items.notes: Liposomal curcumin and resveratrol. Powerful anti-inflammatory and antioxidant combo supporting cellular longevity.

items.name: Rho CoQ10
items.why: Mitochondrial energy — synergistic with NAD+. Helps cells process detox burden.
items.notes: Coenzyme Q10 in liposomal form. Essential for mitochondrial energy production. Works synergistically with NAD+.

items.name: Rho Vitamin C
items.why: Immune + collagen. Antioxidant rapidly depleted during detox.
items.notes: Liposomal vitamin C for enhanced absorption. Supports immune function and collagen production.

items.name: Rho D3K2
items.why: Immune + bone health.
items.notes: Liposomal vitamin D3 with K2 for proper calcium metabolism. Supports immune function and bone density.

items.name: L-Carnitine
items.why: Fatty acid transport into mitochondria
items.notes: Transports long-chain fatty acids into mitochondria for energy production. Especially beneficial during fasted state.

items.name: AHCC (Kinoko Platinum)
items.why: Alpha-glucan immune modulator — different pathway than beta-glucan (TLR-2/TLR-4)
items.notes: Alpha-glucan immune modulator — works through different pathway than beta-glucan (TLR-2/TLR-4). Resets host immunity to clear persistent infections. Add after heavy killing is done. Can also take in Upon Waking block.

items.name: Binder Rotation
items.why: 2+ hrs after supps, 2+ hrs before food. Fasting window = effortless.
items.notes: Rotate between activated charcoal, zeolite, and chlorella daily. These bind toxins released during detox. CRITICAL: Must be 2+ hours away from all other supplements and food or they will bind those instead.

items.name: Diatomaceous Earth (food grade)
items.dose: 1 tsp in water (treat as binder — 2 hrs from everything)
items.why: Mechanical parasite killer — silica edges damage parasite membranes
items.notes: Food-grade diatomaceous earth. The microscopic silica shells mechanically damage parasite membranes in the gut. Treat as a binder: 2+ hours from all other supplements and food. Stir 1 tsp into water and drink.

blocks.name: ~15–20 Min Before First Meal — Pre-Meal (Bile Priming)

items.name: Digestive Bitters
items.dose: 1 dropper on tongue or in small water
items.why: Stimulates vagus nerve → signals liver/gallbladder to produce bile before food arrives
items.notes: Herbal bitters (gentian, dandelion, artichoke, etc.). Taste receptors on the tongue trigger the vagus nerve, which signals the liver and gallbladder to release bile in anticipation of food. Take 15–20 minutes before your first meal for best effect. Can be taken on the tongue or mixed into a small amount of water.

items.name: TUDCA
items.why: Bile flow + liver detox. Absorbs better with food.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Tauroursodeoxycholic acid. Supports bile flow, liver detoxification, and protects liver cells. Higher dose during liver cleanse phase, lower dose ongoing.

items.name: Ox Bile
items.why: Directly supplements insufficient bile — improves fat digestion and fat-soluble vitamin absorption
items.notes:
NEVER take this without food — it can cause harm on an empty stomach.

Bovine bile extract. Directly supplements insufficient bile output, improving fat digestion and absorption of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K). ALWAYS take with fatty meals. Start low (125mg) and titrate up to tolerance — too much can cause loose stools.

items.name: Sunflower Lecithin
items.why: Keeps bile fluid, prevents sludge/stone formation — bile thinner
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Phospholipid-rich granules that keep bile fluid and prevent biliary sludge/stone formation. Stir into food or a smoothie. Soy-free option preferred (sunflower). Tastes slightly nutty, dissolves easily.

items.name: Artichoke Extract
items.why: Increases bile production volume — clinical evidence. Pairs with TUDCA (quality + quantity).
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Cynara scolymus leaf extract (cynarin). Clinical evidence for increasing bile production volume. Complementary to TUDCA: artichoke boosts quantity of bile, TUDCA improves its quality/flow. Better absorbed with food.

items.name: Berberine
items.why: BIOFILM: Jams quorum sensing + antimicrobial. Must have food.
items.notes:
NEVER take this without food — it can cause harm on an empty stomach.

Berberine disrupts bacterial quorum sensing (how biofilm organisms communicate). Also has antimicrobial and blood sugar benefits. ALWAYS take with food — can cause severe nausea on empty stomach.

items.name: Raw Garlic
items.dose: 2 cloves crushed, sit 10 min, eat with first food
items.why: Allicin disrupts parasite cell membranes — mild but persistent pressure
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Allicin disrupts parasite cell membranes — mild but persistent pressure. Crush 2 cloves, let sit for 10 minutes to allow allicin to form, then eat with your first food of the day.

items.name: Wormwood/Cloves/Black Walnut (Clark Triad)
items.dose: Per label — start half dose week 1
items.why: Herbal antiparasitic: wormwood targets adults, cloves target eggs, black walnut targets larvae
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

The Clark parasite triad. Wormwood targets adult parasites, cloves target eggs, black walnut targets larvae — together they cover all life stages. Start at half dose week 1 to gauge tolerance, then ramp to full dose per label.

items.name: Papaya Seeds
items.why: Antiparasitic — carpaine disrupts parasite membranes
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Carpaine in papaya seeds disrupts parasite membranes. Chew 1 tbsp raw seeds (peppery taste) with a meal. Can also blend into smoothies. Fresh seeds from a ripe papaya are most potent.

items.name: Pumpkin Seeds
items.why: Cucurbitin paralyzes worms — aids expulsion
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Cucurbitin in pumpkin seeds paralyzes intestinal worms, aiding their expulsion. Must be raw (roasted loses potency). Chew thoroughly — 1/4 cup 2-3x per week with meals.

items.name: Qunol Turmeric
items.why: ⚠️ FALLBACK: Use until Rho Curcumin arrives, then swap.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Turmeric extract with enhanced absorption. Anti-inflammatory support during detox phases. Fat-soluble — absorbs better with food. TEMPORARY — swap to Rho Curcumin + Resveratrol when it arrives.

Currently using what is on hand — a stopgap, not the intended product.

items.name: Cod Liver Oil
items.why: Omega-3 + vitamin A (mucosal membranes) + vitamin D
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Whole-food source of omega-3s, vitamin A, and vitamin D. Fat-soluble vitamins absorb better with food. Can cause fishy burps on empty stomach.

items.name: Zinc + Copper
items.why: Immune, stomach acid, gut repair.
items.notes:
NEVER take this without food — it can cause harm on an empty stomach.

Zinc supports immune function, stomach acid production, and gut repair. ALWAYS take with food — causes nausea on empty stomach. Take copper alongside zinc to prevent depletion.

items.name: Desiccated Liver
items.why: Whole-food B vitamins, iron, vitamin A.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Grass-fed desiccated liver capsules. Nature's multivitamin — iron content can cause nausea without food.

items.name: Jigsaw Adrenal Cocktail
items.why: ⚠️ FALLBACK: Use until Rho Vitamin C arrives, then swap.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Whole-food vitamin C with sodium and potassium for adrenal support. Better absorbed with food. TEMPORARY — swap to Rho Vitamin C when it arrives.

Currently using what is on hand — a stopgap, not the intended product.

items.name: D3/K2 (current supply)
items.why: ⚠️ FALLBACK: Use until Rho D3K2 arrives, then swap.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Vitamin D3 with K2. Fat-soluble — absorbs better with food. TEMPORARY — swap to Rho D3K2 when it arrives.

Currently using what is on hand — a stopgap, not the intended product.

items.name: RepairVite K-60
items.why: Gut barrier repair — complements Reflux Pro
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Apex Energetics gut repair formula. Contains nutrients that support tight junction integrity. Better tolerated with food.

items.name: Rho Collagen Peptides
items.why: Hair, skin, joints, gut lining.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Hydrolyzed collagen peptides for connective tissue support. Can be taken fasted or with food.

items.name: Super Liver (Super Bonsai)
items.why: 7-herb liver support formula (milk thistle, dandelion, turmeric, ginger, yellow dock, chicory root). Supports liver detox capacity during heavy protocol phases.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

7-herb liver support tincture: milk thistle, dandelion, turmeric, ginger, yellow dock, chicory root. Take 2 full droppers with food. Supports liver detox capacity during the heaviest protocol phases.

items.name: Milk Thistle
items.why: Liver protectant — silymarin shields liver cells during detox
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Standardized silymarin extract. Protects liver cells (hepatocytes) from toxin damage, supports glutathione production, and promotes liver cell regeneration. Especially important during active detox phases. Fat-soluble — absorbs better with food.

items.name: Black Seed Oil
items.why: Anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, immune modulator
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Nigella sativa oil (thymoquinone). Broad-spectrum benefits: anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antimicrobial, and immune-modulating. Supports liver function, gut health, and respiratory health. Studies show activity against biofilms and Candida. Better tolerated with food — can cause mild GI upset on empty stomach.

items.name: Apple Pectin
items.dose: 1 tsp mixed into food or water
items.why: Prebiotic — feeds F. prausnitzii (butyrate producer flagged low on GI-MAP)
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Prebiotic that specifically feeds F. prausnitzii (butyrate producer flagged low on GI-MAP). Start Phase 2 Week 3+ alongside probiotics. Start with 1 tsp — ramp up over 2+ weeks. If significant bloating/gas, cut dose in half and rebuild. Do NOT start until spore probiotics have been active for at least 2 weeks.

items.name: Resistant Starch (Potato Starch)
items.dose: 1 tsp in water or food (ramp to 1 tbsp)
items.why: Third prebiotic lever for butyrate-producer recolonization
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Third prebiotic lever for butyrate-producer recolonization. Must be uncooked — heat destroys resistant starch. Start Phase 2 Week 3+. Start with 1 tsp — ramp up over 2+ weeks. If significant bloating/gas, cut dose in half and rebuild. Do NOT start until spore probiotics have been active for at least 2 weeks.

items.name: Silver Fern Reflux Pro
items.why: Coats/repairs stomach mucosal lining
items.notes: Pour powder directly into mouth and let dissolve. Creates a protective coating on the stomach lining and supports mucosal repair.

items.name: Rho Methylfolate + B12
items.why: Methylation engine — powers toxin processing
items.notes: Active forms of folate and B12. These power the methylation cycle which is essential for processing and eliminating toxins.

items.name: Rho Methylated B-Complex
items.why: Full B vitamin support for energy + nervous system
items.notes: Full-spectrum B vitamins in methylated (active) forms. Supports energy production, nervous system function, and methylation.

items.name: Rho Liposomal TMG
items.why: Methyl donor — feeds methylation cycle
items.notes: Trimethylglycine (betaine). Provides methyl groups that fuel the methylation cycle. Supports liver function and homocysteine metabolism.

items.name: Saccharomyces boulardii
items.why: Probiotic yeast — territory defense against Candida
items.notes: Beneficial yeast that competes with Candida for intestinal real estate. Survives antibiotics and supports gut immune function.

items.name: DGL (Deglycyrrhizinated Licorice)
items.why: Stimulates mucin production — rebuilds lining from underneath while Reflux Pro coats from above
items.notes: Stimulates mucin production in stomach/intestinal lining. Complements Reflux Pro — DGL rebuilds from underneath while Reflux Pro coats from above.

items.name: Silver Fern Cleanse
items.why: Immunoglobulins bind pathogen debris
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Immunoglobulin-based formula that binds to pathogen debris and toxins. Better tolerated after eating.

items.name: Perfect Amino Electrolytes
items.why: Hydration + minerals during fasting + detox
items.notes: Electrolyte powder with amino acids. Sip throughout the afternoon for sustained hydration and mineral replenishment.

items.name: Lymphoria Drops (2nd dose)
items.why: Second dose keeps lymph draining
items.notes: Second daily dose of lymphatic drainage support. Maintains lymph flow throughout the day for continuous toxin removal.

items.name: Acacia Fiber
items.dose: 1 tsp in water (start small, ramp to 1 tbsp)
items.why: Gentle slow-fermenting prebiotic — feeds beneficial bacteria without gas/bloating
items.notes: Gentle slow-fermenting prebiotic — feeds beneficial bacteria without the gas/bloating of other prebiotics. Start when introducing probiotics in Phase 2. Start with 1 tsp — ramp up over 2+ weeks. If significant bloating/gas, cut dose in half and rebuild. Do NOT start until spore probiotics have been active for at least 2 weeks.

items.name: Silver Fern Motility
items.why: Peristalsis via bile + serotonin. NOT a laxative.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Supports natural gut motility through bile stimulation and serotonin receptor activation. Designed to take with meals.

items.name: Orgain Collagen
items.why: ⚠️ FALLBACK: Use until Rho Collagen arrives, then swap.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Collagen protein providing glycine and proline. Better absorbed with food. TEMPORARY — swap to Rho Collagen Peptides when it arrives.

Currently using what is on hand — a stopgap, not the intended product.

items.name: Silver Fern Cleanse (2nd dose)
items.why: Evening immunoglobulin dose
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Second daily dose of immunoglobulin cleanse. Better tolerated with food.

items.name: Rho DIM+
items.why: Estrogen metabolism + hormonal balance. Hold until body is stable — hormonal modulation during active detox makes it impossible to distinguish die-off from DIM+ effects.
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Diindolylmethane supports healthy estrogen metabolism. Fat-soluble — absorbs better with food. PHASES 3-4 ONLY: Hormonal modulation during active detox makes it impossible to distinguish die-off from DIM+ effects.

items.name: Probiotic (multi-strain)
items.why: Microbiome maintenance
items.notes:
Better with food; tolerable with a small snack.

Multi-strain probiotic for ongoing microbiome diversity. Survives stomach acid better when taken with food.

items.name: Inulin/FOS
items.why: Prebiotic — feeds Bifidobacterium and butyrate producers
items.notes: Prebiotic — feeds Bifidobacterium and butyrate producers. Supports cross-feeding relationship with existing B. longum. Start Phase 2 Week 3+. Start with 1 tsp — ramp up over 2+ weeks. If significant bloating/gas, cut dose in half and rebuild. Do NOT start until spore probiotics have been active for at least 2 weeks.

items.name: Body Health Eliminate
items.why: Overnight drainage. Taper as Motility works.
items.notes: Herbal bowel support for overnight drainage and elimination. Start at 2 caps, increase to 4 if needed. Reduce dose if stools become too loose.

items.name: Taurine
items.why: Required for bile acid conjugation — liver can't finish making functional bile acids without it. Also calming.
items.notes: Amino acid required for bile acid conjugation. The liver combines bile acids with taurine (or glycine) to form functional conjugated bile acids. Without adequate taurine, bile composition is impaired. Bonus: taurine has calming/sleep-supporting effects via GABA pathways, making bedtime an ideal timing.

items.name: Magnesium Glycinate (Pure Encapsulations)
items.why: Sleep, relaxation, gentle bowel support. Alternative to Rho Magnesium — use either one.
items.notes: Glycinate form for best absorption and calming effect. Supports sleep, muscle relaxation, and gentle bowel regularity. Most people are deficient in magnesium. Can use this OR Rho Magnesium — your choice.

items.name: Rho Magnesium
items.why: Supports relaxation, sleep quality, gentle bowel support.
items.notes: Liposomal magnesium. Supports relaxation, sleep quality, and gentle bowel regularity. Alternative to Pure Encapsulations Magnesium Glycinate — use either one.

items.name: Rho Sleep Formula
items.why: Rest + recovery. Cellular repair happens during sleep. Supports sleep quality during detox.
items.notes: Liposomal sleep support formula. Recovery happens during sleep — this supports deep, restorative rest.
